title: Verify cheat catalog recipe in an isolated session
changes: Document successful selection and read-only cheat catalog operations through a typed recipe in a real isolated session.
validation: An isolated EUR Wine/Xvfb interpreter selected a discovered synthetic cheat catalog, refreshed its snapshot and listed, inspected and retrieved capabilities for CH-0001 through one six-step recipe. Selection ID, source hash, snapshot generation and returned detail/capability digests matched; a second resume and guest state were unchanged, protected inputs stayed unchanged, and the GUI closed normally.
limitations: This verifies one synthetic catalog and read-only channel flow; it does not verify cheat effects, hardware/device behavior, other catalog content, native Windows or physical input. The successful unit retains private session inputs as a named current proof pending replacement.
